mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iam_operation WHERE actor_scope=#{scope} AND operation_id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT fingerprint,operation_id::text,target_id::text,result_version,action FROM iam_operation WHERE actor_scope=#{scope} AND operation_id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_operation(actor_scope,operation_id,fingerprint,target_id,result_version,action) VALUES(#{scope},CAST(#{row.operationId} AS uuid),#{row.fingerprint},CAST(#{row.targetId} AS uuid),#{row.resultVersion},#{row.action})
